Background.gradient.width.rule: Quarter-percent units: 400 = 100% of container. Soft glows use width 100–200, not 500.

Background.gradient.x.rule: x/y are percent positions of the container (50/50 = center).

Background.absolute.rule: Every absolute decorative layer needs top="0" left="0" or it offsets by parent padding.

Card.interactive.rule: Card is for interactive surfaces only (href or onClick). Static panels use Column + background="surface" border radius="l".

Fade.edge.rule: Fade is an edge overlay strip on scroll containers, not a content wrapper.

RevealFx.delay.rule: Timing props on RevealFx (delay, speed), ShineFx (speed), CountFx (speed), TypeFx (speed, delay), Animation and HoverCard (delay, duration), Hover (delay, hideDelay) and Skeleton (delay) are milliseconds — stagger with delay={index * 100}, never index * 0.1 (that was 1.8.x; 2.0 reads 0.1 as a tenth of a millisecond, i.e. no stagger). speed on MatrixFx, WeatherFx, ParticleFx, CelebrationFx and Effect is a multiplier, where 0.5 is half speed.

RevealFx.translateY.rule: translateY as a number is in rem. Use translateY={1} or token "16" (1rem); 16 means 16rem.

LogoCloud.columns.rule: LogoCloud extends Grid — always set columns and responsive overrides or logos stack in one column.

StatusIndicator.color.rule: StatusIndicator uses color="green" | "red" | "orange" | "gray" etc. — not variant or semantic scheme names.

Icon.names.rule: Icon names must come from iconNames in catalog.json (spec.json has the same list), and IconName is a real union in 2.0 (an unregistered name is a type error, not a blank space). Do not guess a plausible name, and do not cast one with `as IconName` to silence the check. Brand marks are not in the set — an app registers those itself by augmenting IconLibraryOverrides.

Icon.cast.rule: Never cast an icon name with `as IconName`: the cast compiles a name the registry does not have, and it renders nothing. Use a name from iconNames; in data, type the field as IconName ({ icon: IconName }[]) or write the literal `as const`, so the type check still runs.

LayoutProvider.next.rule: In a Next.js app, import LayoutProvider from "@once-ui-system/core/next", not the package root. The root export installs the plain DOM adapters, so SmartLink, Button/Card/ToggleButton with href, Media, Logo, MegaMenu and Kbar render a plain and : no client-side navigation, no next/image, and no error to say so. An app that composes NextAdapterProvider (or AdapterProvider with nextAdapters) itself is already covered.

Toast.stable.rule: Fixed in 2.1: useToast()'s addToast and removeToast keep one identity for the provider's lifetime, so list addToast in an effect's dependencies like any stable callback. Do not hold it in a ref, or leave it out of the deps, to stop the effect re-running when a toast appears. addToast returns the toast's id for removeToast(id); duration is in milliseconds (default 6000, Infinity until closed).

NumberInput.value.rule: Fixed in 2.1: NumberInput follows its value prop after mount (an undo, a reset, a change made elsewhere) without rewriting what the user is typing. Pass value and onChange; do not remount it with a key to push a new value in.

Select.closed.rule: Fixed in 2.1: Select closes on pick and stays closed — focus returning to the field no longer reopens it — and a multiple Select stays open while picking. Use Select with value and onSelect; do not build a local picker from DropdownWrapper and Options to get this.

Button.trigger.rule: Fixed in 2.1: a Button or IconButton that is a DropdownWrapper trigger renders a real <button type="button"> with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, so it is reachable by keyboard. Pass it as trigger as is; do not add type="button" or a no-op onClick, or wrap it in a focusable Row, to make it one.

ContextMenu.contents.rule: Fixed in 2.1: ContextMenu is a real menu (menu and menuitem roles, arrow keys, Home/End, Escape returns focus) that opens at the pointer and stays on screen. Its wrapper is a box; set contents to render none (display: contents), so an absolutely positioned or grid/flex child keeps its own layout. Use ContextMenu with contents instead of a hand-made right-click menu.

Badge.duplicate.rule: Do not pass the same text as both title prop and children — it renders twice.

Timeline.notScrubber.rule: Timeline lays a sequence of steps down the page. For a video or audio editor's timeline — a playhead over stacked tracks of movable, trimmable blocks — use Scrubber. Do not build one out of Flex and absolute positioning.

color.tokens.rule: Colors are semantic tokens ({scheme}-{weight}), never hex/rgb. background also accepts surface | overlay | page | transparent.

color.svgPaint.rule: Inline SVG paint is not a hex or rgb literal either: write fill or stroke as currentColor and set the colour with onBackground on the wrapper, or name a token as var(--brand-solid-strong). A literal never follows the theme.

color.background-weak.rule: *-background-weak is nearly the page color — invisible as accent. Use alpha tokens (brand-alpha-medium) for glows.

api.renamed.rule: Write 2.x prop names, not 1.x ones from memory: open (not isOpen), checked (not isChecked), SegmentedControl value/onChange/defaultValue (not selected/onToggle/defaultSelected), Tag scheme (not variant), field size/prefix/suffix/corners (not height/hasPrefix/hasSuffix/radius). The validator names the 2.x prop.

layout.shorthands.rule: Use fill not fillWidth fillHeight; center not horizontal="center" vertical="center"; Row/Column not Flex direction=, and Row for a Flex with no direction (Flex defaults to row). Flex is for a direction that changes at a breakpoint.

theme.typedProps.rule: Theme a subtree with the typed props theme, themeBorder, themeSolid and themeSurface — on Flex, Row, Column, Grid and every component built on them (Background, Tag, Badge, the effects) — not raw data-theme, data-border, data-solid or data-surface. Keep the raw attribute only where no prop exists: data-border="rounded" on Button and IconButton, data-brand anywhere.

layout.defaults.rule: Never write props equal to defaults or implied by another prop on the element: position="relative", direction on Row/Column, variant="primary" on Button, fillWidth beside maxWidth (maxWidth already fills the width), minWidth={0} beside fillWidth (fillWidth already sets min-width: 0).

border.default.rule: Bare border (and borderTop, borderBottom, borderX, …) draws the default border, neutral-weak. Do not write border="neutral-weak" to get it; name a colour only to deviate, e.g. border="neutral-alpha-weak" (translucent, not the default) or border="brand-alpha-medium".

zIndex.scope.rule: zIndex is for an isolated stacking group: an absolute decorative layer and its content sibling (zIndex={1}), or a sticky header over its pane. Never on a lone element, never a page-wide ladder of 3 / 5 / 9 — restructure the tree instead.

section.gaps.rule: Gap between page sections: 80–160 (typical 104). Inside sections: 24–40.

heading.scale.rule: Hero = display-strong-l/xl; section titles = display-strong-xs/s — never heading-* for section titles.

animation.budget.rule: Entry animation budget: hero + at most 1–2 key moments. Animate coherent blocks all-or-none within a sibling set.

CountFx.trigger.rule: CountFx has no trigger prop — drive value from useInViewport latch instead.

overflow.hero.rule: overflow="hidden" on full-bleed sections clips glows into hard bands — only use when parent has radius.
